name: genealogy
description: Evidence-based genealogy research skills: plan, find sources and archives, read records and handwriting, resolve identities, and write cited conclusions.

interface.longDescription: Evidence-based genealogy research skills: plan, find sources and archives, read records and handwriting, resolve identities, and write cited conclusions. Follows the Genealogical Proof Standard, keeps uncertainty visible and drafts archive requests without sending them.
